$comment: Mission 1.69 §33 and §34. Hard gates first, then a lexicographic tie-break. No weighted numeric score is assigned anywhere.
mission: 1.69 — Independent Product-Relevant Quantity Class Selection V1

scoring_method.why_not_reached: No class passed the hard gates, so there was nothing to break a tie between. Recording that is not the same as recording a tie.

q1_tie_break_preference_not_exercised.$comment: §35 gives Q1 a tie-break preference. It was not used, because §35 is explicit that it is a tie-break only and must not push Q1 through failed gates.

hard_gates_for_strategic_viability: at least two named plausible routes

the_separation_that_matters.$comment: §21. A class failing the same-proposition test is not useless to SROS, and collapsing the two judgements would throw away most of the portfolio.
the_separation_that_matters.statement: Every class evaluated carries real complementary value for the Opportunity Engine. None is currently established as suitable for the same-proposition independence experiment. Those are different questions and this mission answers only the second.

the_pattern_across_rows.observation: Five of eight classes have exactly ONE party positioned to produce the quantity, and one has none of its own — every other publisher of it is a distribution layer.
the_pattern_across_rows.reading: That is Missions 1.46 and 1.57's law recurring across package registries, code forges, publication registries, procurement publishers and attention platforms — five domains it had not been tested in.
the_pattern_across_rows.the_exception_and_why: The three classes with two independent producers are exactly the three whose quantity nobody is positioned to publish authoritatively: what services answer on the internet, what a web server returns for a defined request, and what a resolver receives for a defined query. Each must be established by asking, which is precisely the condition Mission 1.58 identified. The first of the three is the scanner class, which is parked for a different reason — it has two producers and no construct they can both witness, which is Mission 1.68's finding rather than a lineage problem.
